Mega Matrix Inc. has called an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders in Singapore for September 1, 2026, with a record date of August 20, 2026, to vote on major changes to its share capital and governing documents. More about Mega Matrix

The company is listed in the U.S. and files its reports with the Securities and Exchange Commission under Form 20‑F, reflecting a shareholder base governed by Cayman‑style memoranda and articles of association.

Its capital structure features differentiated voting rights, with Class B and Class C shares carrying significantly more votes per share than Class A shares. This architecture is designed to concentrate control among key stakeholders while maintaining broader access to equity capital through its large authorized share base and U.S. registration statements.
